home.introBefore: Founded in 2023 by amplify.dev, we're the team behind Space, DayDream X, DayLight, and more — serving over 6.5 million users in the past year alone. With a growing Discord community of
home.introAfter: members, we build fast, privacy-first SaaS tools designed with user safety at the core. We believe in Control, Privacy, and Freedom — and we strive to create a better internet for everyone.

sponsorship.heading: Sponsorship
sponsorship.description: Help us keep building open, privacy-first tools.

space.name: Space
space.description: Space is a next-gen proxy that has revolutionized the proxy scene with its incredible UI, functionality, and speeds. Space is the flagship proxy for Night Network using never before seen blob cloaking, account system, and more!

daydreamx.name: DayDream Browser
daydreamx.description: Chrome Level Browser written in Typescript capable of running on any browser, anywhere. No installation required. DayDream is a privacy-first browser with a focus on speed, security, and user experience.

linkArchive.name: Link Archive
linkArchive.description: Mass Link storage solution with filter categorization, automatic link generation, and more. themed off of Amplify's Cat.

nyxai.name: NyxAI
nyxai.description: Advanced AI with in your browser. Simple, but Powerful.

daylight.name: DayLight
daylight.description: Daylight is a simplistic proxy with smooth animations, fast speeds, custom themes, and custom extensions. In addition, Daylight has a vertical tab system in a similar style to arc.

starlight.name: StarLight
starlight.description: StarLight is a simple, privacy-first proxy with a focus on simple user experience. StarLight is the successor to Light, with a new design and new features, while retaining a simple calm experience.

umbra.name: Umbra
umbra.description: Umbra is a music player with custom audio visualization, cover rendering, playlist support and sharing, and more. Umbra also has fast speeds and high-quality music.

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.description: As Umbra is music, Aurora is video. Play your videos and media with the same familiar ease from Umbra.

Dusk.name: Dusk
Dusk.description: Dusk is a Node.js comaptibile runtime for the browser. Built to rival WebContainers. Dusk supports Shell, Node.js, Python3, SQLITE, and more to come.

dpm.name: dpm
dpm.description: dpm is a package manager for Dusk. dpm supports multiple forms of "binaries" that can run under the Dusk shell.

Nova.name: Nova
Nova.description: Nova is a Wisp & Moonbeam compatible client. Written in Rust, Nova is a blazing fast client with features that rival libcurl while having speeds like none other. Nova is used in Dusk for Networking, and is the first supported moonbeam client.

Moonbeam.name: Moonbeam
Moonbeam.description: Moonbeam is a networking library. it allows you to create private networks in the browser with support for DHCP, DNS, ICMP, and more. Moonbeam makes use of Wisp for Layer 4 Networking to the internet, allowing you clients to interact with each other, but still get to the internet.

Moonscale.name: Moonscale
Moonscale.description: Tailscale on the Web, connect and run tailscale on your browser in a moonbeam based network. Supports MagicDNS, Tailscale Funnel, Exit Nodes, and more.

LunaSSH.name: LunaSSH
LunaSSH.description: LunaSSH is an advanced rust-based SSH client made to run under moonbeam and wisp, allowing for proxied SSH on the web.
